title.narrative: Project Management Services to the INL East Africa Transnational Organized Crime Regional Program

description.narrative:
"The Department of State/International Narcotics and Law Enforcement (INL) in East Africa has requested UNOPS to provide needed advisory, procurement, and logistics support for program in Comoros, Madagascar, Mauritius, Mozambique, Seychelles and Tanzania. The following activities shall be undertaken to realize this objective.
1. Manage the recruitment, contract management and performance of 6 specialists, jointly with INL, to be deployed to specific locations to work on issues related to maritime security, law enforcement, and rule of law for a period of 36 months 
2. Procurement of goods as per agreed list and specifications for the program
3. Logistics and administrative support for conferences in support of interagency programs as per agreed work plan 
"
